# CareTrackAI

> AI-powered health, memory, and care assistant that helps patients, elderly users, and families track medications, monitor health, and stay coordinated — worldwide.

CareTrackAI combines medication reminders, glucose and vitals tracking, family coordination, and an AI assistant designed for low-tech-literacy users. Built to HIPAA, GDPR, and PDPL standards, available in English, Arabic, Urdu, Spanish and more.
